At number 6, Kyutai launches Pocket TTS, a 100 million parameter voice model that can clone your voice free on your own computer, 6x faster than real time, and to setup is literally one command.

Number 5, Nous Research releases Hermes Skills Hub. Over 90,000 free community skills for your AI agent to work across 200 categories, from OpenAI, Anthropic, NVIDIA and more, installable straight into your agent.

Number 4, xAI ships Grok Imagine Image 2.0. You can now point at any region and change only that, plus background removal, five reference images at once, and smart resize. It’s now number 2 in the world for image editing.

Number 3, Meta launches Muse Code, its first coding agent. It runs in your terminal, keeps background agents alive across the whole session, and works your repo in parallel worktrees so your files are never touched.

Number 2, Alibaba drops Qwen3.8-Max. 2.4 trillion parameters, only 95 billion active, a 1 million token context window, native video and image understanding, and it’s the highest-ranked Chinese model in the world.

And at number 1, someone just open sourced kimi-k3-in-c. A 176 kilobyte pure C99 engine that streams Kimi K3’s experts off your disk instead of loading them into memory letting you run a 2 trillion parameter model with no GPU and 100% open source.
